definition: Valid alarm at injected location; invalid outputs provide no accepted detection. These operational fractions do not infer the content of invalid outputs.
output_logging_limitation: Rejected response content was not retained; only status, input hash, API usage, model, request ID and elapsed time are retained. The cause of output rejection cannot be retrospectively diagnosed.
continuation: After validation failures, only unattempted cases were sent in subsequent invocations. No failed case was retried; no prompt or scoring changes were made.
